progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bk3 and dwells most on Ek in Kereshme Avaz. The line peaks at Ek5 (629.6 Hz) at 1:27.3. It closes on Ek5, not the tonic (Ek4 → Ek4 → D4 → C4 → G4 → Ek5).
